datasets.title: EuRoC MH05 difficult
datasets.sourceLabel: Recorded EuRoC experiment · fixed cohort · repetition 1
datasets.cohort: Archived 17-sequence, 3-repetition metric-publication cohort; distinct from the October 2026 KITTI rerun.
datasets.protocol: Independent rigid SE(3) fit over the whole common support, fixed for all replay frames. No scale fit. ATE uses all original 3D supported poses.
datasets.view: Shared GT principal-axis XY view, equal metric aspect ratio for all methods.
datasets.rendering: Polyline segments must remain disconnected across support gaps; do not smooth, morph, normalize each method independently, or describe replay speed as inference throughput.
datasets.downsampling: Every third supported row plus every contiguous segment endpoint; same selected rows for all methods. Display only, no change to full-support scores.

source.label: Audited EuRoC MH05 difficult aligned trajectory archive

datasets.title: KITTI 06 · fresh rerun
datasets.sourceLabel: Fresh sensor-input rerun · 12 October 2026 · repaired offline configuration
datasets.cohort: Independent KITTI 00–10 rerun; distinct from the archived EuRoC paper cohort.
datasets.protocol: Independent per-trajectory Umeyama Sim(3) translation ATE RMSE, all stride6+last support; equal-weight arithmetic mean over 11 sequences.
datasets.view: Shared camera-frame x/z projection after independent full-support Sim(3) alignment; identical metric aspect ratio.
datasets.rendering: Current displays loop-on by default. 185 original supported rows, stride 6, no extra display downsampling or smoothing. Uniform stride is the evaluation sampling interval, not a missing-support gap.
datasets.downsampling: None beyond the original stride-6 evaluation support.
datasets.configuration: Repaired offline whole-sequence admission; not the paper original frozen configuration.

source.label: Sealed KITTI 06 fresh predictions and external evaluation ground truth
